title: Professional Email Mailbox Capacity and Retention Sheet
content:
Mailbox limits of each Professional Email product, per seat unless stated otherwise in the column heading.

| Product | Mailbox storage (GB) | Archive storage (GB) | Largest attachment sent (MB) | Aliases per mailbox | Shared mailboxes included without a seat | Recipients per mailbox per day | Spam quarantine (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 10 | 0 (none) | 25 | 10 | 0 | 500 | 15 |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 30 | 0 (none) | 25 | 25 | 2 | 1000 | 15 |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 50 | 0 (none) | 50 | 50 | 5 | 1500 | 30 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 50 | 50 | 150 | 400 | 25 | 10000 | 30 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 50 | 50 | 150 | 400 | 25 | 10000 | 30 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 50 | 1500 | 150 | 400 | 25 | 10000 | 30 |

## Storage warnings and full mailboxes

| Product | Warning issued at | Full mailbox stops sending until space is freed |
|---|---|---|
| All six Professional Email products | 90 percent of mailbox storage | Yes |

## Deleted mailboxes

| Product | Calendar days a deleted mailbox can be restored | Restore fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| All six Professional Email products | 30 | 0.00 |

## Notes on the sheet

- An archive figure of 0 means the product has no archive mailbox.
- Mailbox storage, attachment size, send limits, aliases and quarantine follow the figures of the product the subscription is on.
- Hypothetical comparison: a team needing 40 GB per mailbox and 2000 recipients per mailbox per day is within Microsoft 365 Business Basic (50 GB, 10000 recipients) and beyond Harborline Mail Pro on sending (1500 recipients).
